subject: Refund for last month
body: Hi, I was charged EUR 29 four days ago but I haven't used the product at all this month. Can I get that refunded?

subject: Refund of annual invoice
body: We were billed EUR 4,800 for the annual plan six days ago, but procurement has not approved the renewal. Please refund the full amount.

subject: Charged twice this month
body: My bank statement shows two identical charges for my Pro subscription this month. Please fix this.

subject: Card declined - how do I update it?
body: I got an email that my card was declined. I have a new card, where do I change it?

subject: Forgot my password
body: I can't remember my password and I'm locked out. Can you help me get back in?

subject: Password not working
body: My password suddenly stopped working this morning. Please send me a reset link.

subject: No verification email
body: I signed up for the trial yesterday but never received the verification email. I checked spam too.

subject: SAML SSO error 500 for all our users
body: Since 08:00 every user in our company gets an HTTP 500 error from the SAML SSO login. Nobody on our team can log in to work.

subject: Dashboard extremely slow
body: The charts on my dashboard take over a minute to load today. Is something wrong?

subject: CSV export fails
body: Our finance team cannot export reports to CSV, the export just fails with an error.

subject: Export button gives an error
body: When I click Export to CSV I get 'Something went wrong'. Tried twice.

subject: API returning 500 on /v2/orders
body: Every request to /v2/orders has returned HTTP 500 for the last 20 minutes. Our checkout integration is down.

subject: Typo on settings page
body: Small thing: the settings page says 'Notifcations' instead of 'Notifications'.

subject: Mobile app crashes on photo upload
body: The mobile app crashes every time I try to upload a photo, so I can't submit my work reports.

subject: Feature request: dark mode
body: Would love a dark mode option, the white UI is hard on the eyes at night.

subject: Audit log API
body: Our compliance team would like an API to pull audit logs into our SIEM. Is that on the roadmap?

subject: Google Calendar integration?
body: Please add a Google Calendar integration, it would make this so much more useful for me.

subject: Cancel my subscription
body: Please cancel my Pro subscription at the end of the current period.

subject: Notice of non-renewal
body: This is to inform you that Helix Logistics will not renew our contract when it ends this month.

subject: How do I cancel my trial?
body: I don't want to be charged when the trial ends. How do I cancel?

subject: Stolen laptop - revoke sessions
body: One of our employees had their laptop stolen last night. Please revoke all their active sessions immediately.

subject: Unknown login from Brazil
body: I got an alert about a login from Brazil. I have never been there. I think someone accessed my account.

subject: Phishing email pretending to be you
body: I received an email that looks like yours asking me to confirm my card details on a strange website. Forwarding it to you.

subject: GDPR data export request
body: Under GDPR Article 20 we request an export of all personal data you hold about our EU users.

subject: Delete all my data
body: I want to exercise my right to erasure. Please delete my account and all my personal data.

subject: What data do you store?
body: Just curious, what kind of personal data do you store about me?

subject: Change my account email
body: Please change the email address on my account to tomasz.w.new@example.com.

subject: Wrong VAT number on invoice
body: Our latest invoice shows an outdated VAT number. We need a corrected invoice for our accounting.

subject: Lost access after payment failed
body: I can't get into my dashboard since my payment failed last week. How do I get access back?

subject: Student discount?
body: Do you offer a student discount on the paid plans?
